name: glitch-daemon
description: Glitch Local DevOps Daemon powered by SQLite and Node.js standard library

scripts.db:status: node -e 'import("./src/db.mjs").then(m => { const { db, dbPath } = m.initDatabase(); console.log("DB:", dbPath); console.log("Tables:", db.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=\"table\"").all()); db.close(); })'
